description: Add or remove a country's GST/VAT — or its other national consumption tax, such as Japan's consumption tax or Malaysia's SST — on a monetary amount, returning the net / tax / gross split. Use it to convert between tax-exclusive and tax-inclusive prices (invoices, quotes, receipts); for the rates themselves use tax_rate_lookup. Pure arithmetic on the current standard rate, rounded to 2 decimals, in the local currency. Pass region for a state or provincial rate (CA, US): in Canada that is GST plus the provincial tax, in the US the state sales tax. A country with no national rate (the US without a region, or a country with no consumption tax) returns an explanatory error instead of a wrong number.

amount.description: The monetary amount in the local currency — tax-exclusive when mode=add, tax-inclusive when mode=remove

country.description: 2-letter ISO 3166-1 code of the country whose GST/VAT rate applies (case-insensitive)

mode.description: 'add' puts tax on top of a net amount; 'remove' extracts the tax already inside a gross amount

region.description: Optional state or province code, for sub-national sales tax. Held for CA (13 provinces and territories), US (51 states incl. DC). E.g. 'ON' (Ontario) with country CA, or 'CA' (California) with country US. Answered from that state's or province's own cited rate; US figures are the state rate only — local sales taxes are not included.

name: compute_gst_vat

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

rate.description: Standard rate applied, as a fraction

region.description: State or province whose rate was applied — present only when region was passed

regionName.description: What applies in that region, in a sentence

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

title: GST/VAT add or remove calculator
